description: Use for questions about results and goals: "what's my ROAS?", "how much did I spend?", "am I on track this month?". Returns saved Meta ads totals (spend, revenue, ROAS, purchases, click rate, cost per click, frequency) and this month's ROAS goal with the gap to it. For where buyers drop out use get_sales_funnel; for per ad tiredness use get_ad_fatigue. Saved data, refreshed by the hourly check.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
